_comment: Stock words the Writing guideline (guidelines/writing.html) asks Vici's pages and starters to leave out. The Writing page renders this table with the @banned-words widget, and check-docs fails when any word marked for checking appears in the visible text of a docs page or starter. Words that are only filler when used figuratively, such as landscape, set check to false: the page lists them, the check leaves them alone.
_allow: Forms of a stock word that are fine in Vici: elevated is the name of a shadow level and a card variant.

groups.instead: say what is quicker or gone: “one click”, “no sign-in”
say what it handles: “10,000 rows”, “works offline”
say what the reader can now do
say what got shorter or faster
important, or say why it matters
complete, or say what it covers
also, or start a new sentence
say what works together, or what changed
leave it out and describe the thing
when figurative, name the thing: the market, the process, the field
